optimization: Same encoder initialization, AdamW, natural movement frequency and uniform title sampling as joint SFT v1.
supervision: Stage 1 only. Four distinct TH10 and four distinct TH12 training players, plus the former six TH13 players. Two held players per title.
metrics: Compare v1, v2 at 3000, v2 at 9000 on the same six unseen players. Report movement NLL, switching, starts, turns and Bomb onset counts.
selection: Keep both checkpoints; this is a controlled training-budget and data experiment. Original game evaluation is separate.
